title: The Pale Terminal
author: Gideon Blackwood
blurb: Ansel Galloway, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
